subject: B2 shared forest wind, moving sun shadows and stable LOD/rebase phase

notes: All four production challenge checkpoint payloads and cameras are identical before and after; the boss uses the same approach point in both versions.
One short run per version. GPU browser workloads did not overlap. Environment time is continuous and not phase-locked; this is not a cost bound or evidence of a speedup.
The wind shader changes neither instance transforms nor authoritative terrain, navigation, attack cover, population or gameplay RNG.
CPU is map main-thread work and excludes authority Worker CPU and loading spikes. Live movement is wall-clock input, not a fixed-tick replay.
GPU bytes are resource-ledger estimates, not driver VRAM. The four paused route points keep the same draw counts; shaders add vertex arithmetic.
Screenshots/rendering are native 1440p, video is 720p. Samples remain too short for a complete game or minimum-hardware 60 FPS certification.
Controlled browser pixels separately verify root anchoring, colour/depth deformation, LOD phase, time wrap and rebasing. Existing LOD silhouette changes remain.
